sources.title: 台北国图 08346《桯史》长水岳氏刊本馆藏与公共影像
sources.provider: National Central Library scans and copy description via Wikimedia Commons
sources.quality_notes: The mirror copy description gives shelfmark 310.21 08346, five fascicles and a seal list distinct from 08345. Page-level readings are documented separately, with no independent edition, common blocks, or precise impression assigned.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Direct transmission from P.4071 to the Ming Ziwei main-star or transformations systems is unproved.
08345 and 08346 reinforce one edition-family reading without establishing two independent recensions.
unresolved_lineage_questions: P.4071 lacks an hour stem in the reviewed opening and does not establish the genealogy of later Ziwei rules.
The Yuan Shao episode is not dated separately in the reviewed text; the 1201 date belongs to the earlier Jiujiang episode.
The four pairs, transformations and branch grouping do not attest a procedure for computing the hour stem or a complete day-master system.
Two separately numbered copies of the same cataloged edition family are not two independent recensions. Common woodblocks and exact impressions remain unbound.
The 1934 facsimile's reported Yuan exemplar has not been collated in this batch.
